# Climate Watch greenhouse-gas emissions via World Bank WDI

Source record for World Bank WDI indicator `EN.ATM.GHGT.KT.CE`, used by the historical `Medium-Blog/clima_portugal` analysis.

## Current authoritative provenance

World Bank indicator metadata identifies:

- Indicator: **Total greenhouse gas emissions (kt of CO2 equivalent)**
- Source: **Climate Watch Historical GHG Emissions (1990–2020), World Resources Institute**
- Climate Watch source: https://www.climatewatchdata.org/ghg-emissions
- World Bank metadata: https://databank.worldbank.org/metadataglossary/world-development-indicators/series/EN.ATM.GHGT.KT.CE
- Licence: **CC BY-NC 4.0**
- Licence URL: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/

This dataset must not inherit the generic World Bank open-data default. The indicator-specific metadata controls.

The historical Medium file `API_EN.ATM.GHGT.KT.CE_DS2_en_csv_v2_5607282.csv` remains with the article. The notebook-derived `total-ghg-emissions.csv` also stays project-local.
